QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Performance and Benchmarking_11

question.text: Kalpavriksha Venture Fund III reports TVPI = 1.76 and RVPI = 1.50 at the end of Year 4. What is DPI at Year 4?

explanation.text: The Logic: DPI + RVPI = TVPI (Section 7.3.4.4). Therefore DPI = TVPI - RVPI = 1.76 - 1.50 = 0.26. The fund has distributed 26 paise per rupee of paid-in capital as at Year 4. The Trap: 3.26 adds instead of subtracting. 1.76 copies TVPI. 1.50 copies RVPI. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C, XIX-A test the identical decomposition identity. XXI-B PMS has no DPI/RVPI decomposition; returns are TWR-based NAV deltas. Manager's Pro-Tip: A Y4 DPI of 0.26 is normal for a VC/Growth fund still in investment-harvest transition — don't let LPs misread low DPI as weak performance. Always co-present RVPI and TVPI trajectory.
